reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode, data through Nov 6 (fresh, not stale). SPX 7,376.86 is -5.96% from its 120-day high, -3.94% below its 50-day but +0.71% above its 200-day (7,325.05). SMH 463.96 sits BELOW Zone 2 (470-505), -30.94% from its high; NVDA 186.64 is between zones, just above its 175-185 Zone 2. VIX 25.64 is rolling over from a 28.18 five-day high but still above the 25 stand-down line; HY OAS 3.48 is calm. Mechanical tally 3 of 4, with zone occupancy the missing leg.
reaction.invalidation: A confirmed bottom — SMH Zone 2 print with VIX under 25, tally at 3/4 or better, and SPX holding above 7,325 on the second low — voids Watch and arms Tranche A. Conversely, a credit event (HY OAS above 4% sustained) or a weekly SPX close below its 200-day at 7,325.05 voids the correction framing into a deeper drawdown regime.

ladder.response: Tranche A arms — 25% starter per the deployment ladder, sized at the Zone 2 print, not before.
ladder.trigger: SMH daily close inside 470-505 with VIX closing below 25 and tally at 3/4 or better

ladder.response: Escalation to the next zone down: stay Watch, no Tranche A; the second low near the 200-day is the buyable one only if it holds with volume and the tally rebuilding.
Trap case: treat as a sell zone, not a chase — the first bounce fails until a second low holds; no new entries into the rally.
ladder.trigger: Rally into the failure zone — SPX 7,750-7,820 or SMH 580-600

ladder.response: Stand-down / regime break: no new exposure, watchlist frozen, re-audit zones and ratios before any deployment.
ladder.trigger: VIX closes above 28.18 (5-day high) or HY OAS above 4%

reaction.trapRisk: Friday's bounce (SMH +3.62%, QQQ +1.62%, VST +10.42%) is the first bounce after the washout, not confirmation. Pivot-and-fail risk is high: chasing it risks buying into the 7,750-7,820 failure zone. Entries wait for the failed first bounce and a second low near the 200-day at 7,325.05 that holds — no chasing the first green day.

strategyPosture: Watch. The correction episode is intact, Friday was the washout bounce rather than confirmation, and no name has printed inside a buy zone — SMH is below Zone 2, NVDA is between zones, VIX is still above 25. Cash stays king and the deployment ladder stays unarmed until a zone print, a VIX close under 25, and the tally rebuilding coincide.

themes.counterRead: The divergence is real and worth tracking, because credit conditions can flip — but as of the Nov 6 close there is no credit confirmation of a rollover. Treating a Mag7 unwind as a broad-market collapse would misread the tape; the risk to watch is the rotation spreading, not the rotation itself.
themes.dataAnchor: The concentration read is ROTATION_NOT_ROLLOVER. Mag7 averages -17.44% from 52-week highs versus SPY at -5.9% — an 11.54-point divergence gap — while bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%, far below the ~40% stress threshold) and HY OAS is 3.48, calm and below the 4% stand-down line. SPX itself is only -5.96% from its 120-day high. Index-level calm masks concentrated weakness in the handful of names that dominate the index by weight, but the credit channel is not breaking.
themes.label: Rotation, not rollover
themes.narrative: The tape reads as a broad market break: QQQ is -12.05% over one month and the AI complex is down 20-40% from highs, which invites a rollover call.
themes.watchFor: HY OAS crossing above 4% or SLOOS tightening toward stress levels — either would convert rotation into rollover.

themes.counterRead: A DATA_AHEAD read is an opportunity only with a trigger, not a buy call on its own. Nothing in the ladder arms yet: SMH is BELOW Zone 2 (463.96 vs the 470-505 band) and NVDA sits between zones at 186.64, above its 175-185 Zone 2. The gap between price and fundamentals is the setup; the zone print is the entry.
themes.dataAnchor: Revenue is still growing fast where the price fell hardest. NVDA revenue is +61.4% YoY at $186.64 (-23.3% from high, RSI 30.8); AVGO +55% YoY with a 42.1% free-cash-flow margin at -40.7% from high; LRCX +131.3% YoY at -54.3% from high; DDOG +27.7% YoY at -40.5% from high; VRT +27.7% YoY at -51.9% from high. Top conviction scores run 78-85 (AVGO 85, DDOG 84, ONTO 83) on exactly this gap — fundamentals and price moving in opposite directions.
themes.label: AI washout: price collapsed, fundamentals did not
themes.narrative: The market has priced the AI complex as if demand broke: SMH is -30.94% from its high and -23.1% over 20 days, with 35 dislocations across the universe, most flagged SENTIMENT_DRIVEN with RSI readings of 26-40.
themes.watchFor: SMH daily close inside 470-505 or NVDA daily close inside 175-185 — the Zone 2 print that converts the gap into an armed Tranche A.

themes.counterRead: The bounce is real buying — +23% in a day on OKLO is a washout signature — but it has no confirmation leg behind it: no zone print, VIX still above 25, SPX still below its 50-day. The episode block frames the week ahead as a second-low test near the 200-day; Friday's bounce is the first leg of that test, not its result.
themes.dataAnchor: The bounce has no confirmation leg behind it. SPX closed 7,376.86, still -3.94% below its 50-day (7,679.45); SMH at 463.96 is still below the 470 Zone 2 floor; VIX closed 25.64, rolling over from a 28.18 five-day high but still above the 25 stand-down line; and the mechanical tally is 3 of 4 with zone occupancy — the leg that matters — still false. One-month damage is untouched by one green day: ASTS -42.93%, RDDT -38.87%, CONL -43.09% over the month.
themes.label: Friday's bounce is the washout bounce, not confirmation
themes.narrative: Friday's tape invites a bottom call: QQQ +1.62%, SMH +3.62%, and violent single-name pops — TMDX +27.72%, OKLO +23.18%, RKLB +16.48%, SMR +15.56%, VST +10.42% — after a week that took TQQQ -34.53% over one month.
themes.watchFor: A failed first bounce followed by a second low near the 200-day at 7,325.05 that holds — or a rally into the 7,750-7,820 failure zone, which would confirm the trap.

themes.counterRead: Friday's snapback is one session, not a turn — the month is still down 20-31% across the group and VST's revenue inflection is flagged DETERIORATING even at a 2.4x P/S. The data-ahead case (cheap price, insider buying at the trough, positive revenue growth) is real, but a single-day bounce does not confirm a bottom; the read stays research until the group holds Friday's gains into next week.
themes.dataAnchor: VST closed $124.80, still -36.6% from its high with revenue +19.1% YoY, P/S 2.4x, and insiders having bought $1.17M at the trough; conviction score 80. But the one-month picture is still deep red: VST -20.17%, OKLO -31.59%, SMR -31.01%, CCJ -17.61% over the month, and VST's revenue inflection is flagged DETERIORATING.
themes.label: Nuclear / AI power: the print confirmed, the price has not
themes.narrative: Power is the AI bottleneck, and the market chased it Friday: VST +10.42%, OKLO +23.18%, SMR +15.56%, CCJ +5.05%, URA +4.20% in a single session.
themes.watchFor: OKLO or SMR giving back more than half of Friday's gains (+23.18% / +15.56%) voids the bottom read; VST holding above $124.80 keeps the data-ahead case alive.

themes.counterRead: Credit is a lagging confirmer, not a leading all-clear: HY OAS at 3.48 can gap if a second AI borrower cracks or the Dec 8-9 FOMC surprises. The calm is the condition that lets a bottom hold when it forms — it is not itself the bottom.
themes.dataAnchor: The credit data does not support a funding break. HY OAS is 3.48, calm and below the 4% stand-down line; bank lending standards are LOOSE at SLOOS 1.7%; the 2s10s curve is +0.38 (un-inverted); the 10-year is 4.84% with the real 10-year at 2.61% and breakeven inflation (T10IE) at 2.23%. The December FOMC decision (Dec 8-9) is the active high-signal event on the calendar, but nothing in the current credit prints argues for a funding break before it.
themes.label: Credit calm, rates steady: the funding channel is not the break
themes.narrative: With equities down 5-6% from highs and the AI complex down 30%, the fear narrative says the funding channel must be cracking — the bubble thesis is leveraged credit, not AI itself.
themes.watchFor: HY OAS above 4% sustained, or any second AI borrower cracking — either voids the correction framing.

watchFor: SPX holding above 7,325 (200-day) on the second-low test, or breaking below it
HY OAS staying below 4% (above 4% sustained = regime break)
whereWaveBuilds: The next move builds at the second-low test near the 200-day — SPX closed 7,376.86, just +0.71% above its 200-day at 7,325.05. The trigger is SMH re-entering Zone 2 (470-505) or NVDA holding its 175-185 Zone 2 on that test; a failed first bounce into the 7,750-7,820 failure zone is the trap to avoid, not the entry.
